issues.description: Uses `dtype=` in `from_pretrained` despite the declared transformers floor expecting `torch_dtype=`, risking model-load failure.
`generate-stories` calls `load_manifest` before generating, so a clean checkout with no manifest cannot bootstrap story data.
Generated `emovec.egg-info` and `outputs/` artifacts are ignored but present in the repo, making source state inconsistent and non-reproducible.
Default config points at `data/stories`, but the checked-in tree has no story files, so extraction fails from a clean repo.
Single-token or empty texts can produce `L - s == 0`, causing division by zero or empty activation averages.
`emotion_vectors` silently takes the mean of empty slices when an emotion has no stories, yielding NaN vectors.
Story parsing treats any preamble before the first `<NEW STORY>` marker as an actual story.
HTTP story generation has no timeout, retry handling, or explicit error handling, so it can hang indefinitely or fail opaquely.
`load_vectors` does not validate manifest/model/emotion/shape compatibility before downstream validation or steering uses saved arrays.
`validate-contexts` and `steer-prefs` load the full model before checking whether extraction artifacts exist.
`all_token_activations` stacks every hidden state for all tokens in memory, which can OOM on larger neutral corpora.
Runtime dependencies are broad lower bounds with no lockfile or upper bounds, undermining reproducibility.
`requirements.txt` duplicates broad unpinned dependencies and mixes runtime with test dependency `pytest`.
The only story-loader coverage is skipped when the story dataset is absent, which is exactly the current repo state.
`n_steered_emotions` is not validated against the emotion count, so bad config can select duplicate emotions and overwrite outputs.
